CustomField.description: The words that explain the number on this project's case study card on the home page. The case study cards read the Case Metric fields and the "How this site is built" section reads the Headline Metric fields. Shown only when Case Study Metric is also set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: One plain sentence fragment that says what the number counts, 120 characters at most. It may hold {n} for the number when a source is picked.
CustomField.label: Case Study Metric Label
